dataset.name: Optical Recognition of Handwritten Digits (UCI), test set as bundled with scikit-learn
dataset.inputDescription: 8x8 grayscale images of handwritten digits, pixel intensity 0 to 16

model.type: Multinomial logistic regression (softmax regression, a single-layer neural network)

split.strategy: stratified random split of the 1,797 images

calibration.reference: Guo et al. (2017), On Calibration of Modern Neural Networks
calibration.fitObjective: negative log-likelihood on the validation split

reference.note: Computed by ml/train_calibration_demo.py (NumPy) for cross-checking the website's TypeScript metrics.

robustness.note: The same pipeline repeated with different random splits. Seed 0 is the run shown on the website.
